cover.title: 5 AI Trainer Apps
cover.subtitle: I ranked 5 — but #3 is the only one that knows if it's working.

caption: I ranked 5 AI personal trainers 🤖 They'll all program your workouts — but #3 is the only one that actually tells you if it's working, reading your body fat and muscle from a single progress photo. It's the one I check every week. GainFrame is free on iOS. Which trainer are you on? #aitrainer #fitnessapps #gymtok #fitnesscoach #bodycomposition

apps.name: Ray: AI Personal Trainer
apps.store_desc:
Meet Ray — your AI personal trainer. Voice-guided strength training that listens, adapts, and remembers what works for you. All the benefits of a personal trainer for a fraction of the price.

No more staring at your phone between sets. No more guessing what to do at the gym. Just show up, and Ray handles the rest.

TRAINING THAT FITS YOUR LIFE

Real trainers are effective because they know you — your schedule, your injuries, your goals. But at $100-200/hour, most people can't afford that.

Ray
apps.description: A talkative AI coach that adjusts every set in real time. The most hands-on guidance here — for a price.
